title: GeneratedIndex
description: Schema for the generated, single-shot read snapshots that renderers consume — for example backpack/_index.json or doctrine/doctrine.lock.json. These files are MACHINE-WRITTEN by a build step and SHOULD NOT be hand-edited; the per-file markdown frontmatter is the source of truth. The index exists so narrator, statusline, daily-brief, and Claude bootstraps can keep doing one read.

version.description: Semver of the index format itself.

source_commit.description: Optional git SHA of the source tree this index was built from. Lets renderers detect drift.

source_root.description: Optional path to the source tree (e.g. 'backpack/').

pinned_keys.description: Convenience copy of pinned ids, mirroring legacy _config:pinned_keys for backpack-index.

items.description: The materialized layer. Object-of-id form preserves backpack.json compatibility; array form is also accepted.

oneOf.description: Map of id -> item. Each value matches the corresponding per-item schema (backpack-item.schema.json or doctrine-entry.schema.json or hoard-item.schema.json).

stats.description: Optional build-time stats useful for diagnostics.
